name: Alloette Allay
description: It glides through the meadows singing a graceful lullaby. If it hears music, it can't help but be drawn to it and dance around. They say that if you give an Alloette a gift, it will be loyal to you for the rest of its life.

name: Beryllius Emerald
description: Beryllius is able to channel the energy of the earth to create emeralds between its hands. Because of this, it sees no value in traditional wealth, rather it gifts its gemstones to young children who better appreciate their splendor.

name: Carbink Amethyst
description: This form of Carbink is born during the formation of underground geodes. When light refracts through its amethyst crystals, its psychic powers awaken.

name: Carbink Echo
description: This form of Carbink is only found in the deepest darkest depths of the caves. It is unknown how it came into being... Its body reverberates with sound, said to be echoes of the past.

name: Carbink Emerald
description: This form of Carbink is born from the high pressure when mountains form. Its emerald-green glow makes it a favorite of the Villagers.

name: Clarissie Amethyst
description: By exerting its psychic powers, Clarissie has to power to create amethyst crystals between its hands. It can shoot beams of light through its crystals to amplify their power.

name: Darmanitan Blazing Mode=Zen-Mode Aspect=Mega
description: Although it appears to be asleep, its mind is awake. Mega Evolution has allowed this Pokemon to open its third eye, granting it a deep sense of understanding. It uses its control over its own mind to unleash its latent psychic power.

name: Dhelmise Sculk
description: When reanimated Sculk wrapped around a large ancient pickaxe this Pokemon was born. The Sculk covering the pickaxe is actually its body, and it uses the tool to dig through the caves looking for unsuspecting individuals lost in the mines. If it finds its prey, it wraps their bodies in Sculk before leeching away their vitality.

name: Dudunsparce
description: Mega Evolution has awakened its dormant genes, elongating its body into a serpent-like form. Using its tiny wings, it flies through the air as if pretending to be a majestic dragon.

name: Echolyte Echo
description: This Pokemon is so rarely seen that many scientists debate whether or not its truly alive. The shards that encircle its body protect its soft spirit-like core. Few people have seen it without its outer shell.

name: Falinks Gunslinger
description: The five individuals stack on top of each other, acting as one. Their towering position allows them to more easily aim and fire with the cannons on their heads, with less risk of friendly fire. The brass on the top of the stack commands the bottom-most trooper and directs them in the direction it wants to go.

name: Falinks Last Soldier
description: Even after losing its five troopers in battle, the Last Soldier refuses to retreat. Its fallen comrades continue to fight alongside their leader, empowering them with ghostly aura. This power allows it to face even the strongest armies without faltering.

name: Flabebe Allay
description: Its body is as light as a feather, letting its wings guide it through wind currents to travel the world. As it flies it hums a beautiful tune.

name: Fomantis Lunar
description: Unlike its tropical counterpart, this form of Fomantis is nocturnal. It awakens from its slumber to bask in the full moon's light, using this energy for photosynthesis. The light of the moon strengthens its psychic powers.

name: Gallade Goth Aspect=Mega Y
description: By channeling the power of Mega Evolution, it can cast the area around it in shadows even under the brightest sunlight.

name: Gallade Goth
description: This Pokemon, incapacitating them with its blades before draining them of their vitality. People who live near its territory caution to stay away from shady locations.

name: Gardevoir Goth Aspect=Mega Y
description: The immense energy brought upon by Mega Evolution grants it immense power, but at a cost of triggering its appetite. If its trainer isn't careful, Gardevoir may try to sneak a bite to drain some of their vitality.

name: Gardevoir Goth
description: It uses its elegant appearance to lure people in, giving them a false sense of security before biting their neck and draining them of their vitality. Despite being known for its vanity, many folktales claim that this Pokemon has no reflection.

name: Ghast
description: This Pokemon propels itself through the air by filling its balloon-like body with gas. Though it lives in the Nether, its body can adapt to the amount of moisture in its environment. The more moisture it has, the happier and healthier it is.

name: Hatenna Midnight
description: This Pokemon is sensitive to human emotions. Because of this, it does everything it can to keep people happy. It uses its hat to perform all sorts of tricks to impress others.

name: Hattrix Midnight
description: Hattrix uses the braids on its head to juggle fireballs. It puts on performances to cheer people up when they're sad, because its sensitive to negative emotion.

name: Kirlia Goth
description: It is said that a Kirlia will absorb the negative emotions of its trainer. This Pokemon prefers to keep to itself, picking petals off of flowers and thinking melancholy thoughts.

name: Leavanny Clockwork Aspect=Mega
description: The spool of silk that powers the machine has split open, causing the silk to pour out uncontrollably. Its unclear how it still functions, some believe its only able to sustain itself in this form by using Mega Energy as its power source.

name: Leavanny Clockwork
description: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokemon Leavanny. Though its exact origin is unknown, it appears to have been built long ago. It dances a perpetual dance, a novelty considering how archaic the technology is.

name: Lilligant Winter
description: The garland on its head is often mistaken for a flower. In reality its red petals are actually leaves. They turn a bright shade of red during winter, making it very popular during the holidays.

name: Lucario Y Aspect=Mega Y
description: It radiates a powerful aura due to the power of Mega Evolution. Using this power, it can fire off pulses of aura that can shatter solid diamond. It has no mercy in its heart.

name: Lucario Y
description: Its fighting style is ruthless and brutal, and it shows its opponents no mercy. Its aura is overflowing, allowing it to sense its opponent's moves before they even make them. When the eyes on its hands open, it launches bursts of aura that can turn steel into dust.

name: Lurantis Lunar
description: This Pokemon uses its orchid-like appearance to blend into its surrounding as it soaks in moonlight. Although it resembles a bug, its actually a flower. It goes into a mantis-like stance and attacks with psychic blades when threatened by bug types drawn to its scent.

name: Mega Alloette Allay
description: Through the power of Mega Evolution, Alloette's soul has split into two. The two halves work together in unison, bound together by the amethyst crystal they carry between them.

name: Mega Dudunsparce Y
description: Mega Evolution has awakened its dormant genes, causing its wings to grow large allowing it to take flight. By flapping its wings it can stir up hurricanes to attack its foes.

name: Mega Electrode
description: Through Mega Evolution its appearance has changed to resemble a Master Ball. Contained within its body is a large quantity of Infinity Energy, which it releases to cause cataclysmic explosions.

name: Mega Falinks Gunslinger
description: Through the power of Mega Evolution, all five troops combined together to form a tank. They work in unison to pilot the machine that is their body. The brass that make up the wheels of the treads get dizzy from rotating after long journeys.

name: Mega Falinks Last Soldier
description: Through the power of Mega Evolution, the Last Soldier becomes one with its fallen troops. Theirs souls link together to form an unstoppable force able to topple a thousand armies.

name: Mega Klinklang
description: Mega Evolution has converted its body into a living engine. The gears that make up its body act in unison to propel it across the ground at high speeds. It can reach speeds of over 230 mph.

name: Mega Stonjourner Sandstone
description: It stands in the middle of the desert as a monument of safety. Its body acts as shelter for wild Pokemon caught amidst raging sandstorms.

name: Meloetta Song Forme=Acoustic
description: Meloetta has been empowered by lively spirits roused by its song, blessing it with electric energy. Its mood has brightened, filling it with furvor. Though its still blind, the power of its ancestors has heightened its senses. Because of this, it has removed the bandages covering its eyes, using it to tie its hair in a ponytail.

name: Meloetta Song Forme=Soprano
description: Because it is blind, this Pokemon is not afraid of the dark. It lives deep below in the Ancient Cities that remind it of its home. Its soft soprano voice echoes through the caves as it sings and plays its violin, filling the silence with an eerie yet beautiful song. Legends say its music can calm restless spirits.

name: Morelull Crimson
description: This form of Morelull is adapted to live in the Crimson Forest biome. It absorbs heat from the ground using its mycelium, and uses that energy to light its mushroom cap. When eaten, its cap is said to have an extremely spicy flavor.

name: Morelull Warped
description: This form of Morelull is adapted to live in the Warped Forest biome. It flashes its lights in a rythmic pulse to hypnotize its prey, then latches onto them to drain their vitality. When eaten, its cap is said to have an extremely sour flavor.

name: Petilil Winter
description: This form of Petilil is adapted to thrive in frigid cold climates.

name: Phantasmare Bad
description: After being imbued with negative thoughts, this Pokemon sneaks into people’s bedrooms to sprinkle their beds with its magic sand. The sand that makes up its body induces terrifying nightmares.

name: Phantump Pale
description: The spirit of a deceased Phantump. Its wooden body has long-since petrified, becoming hard as stone. During the day it remains as still as a statue, but at night it stirs from its slumber to wander the pale forest it calls home.

name: Pillowisp Bad
description: When a pillow is inhabited by a wandering spirit laying to rest, it becomes this Pokemon’s pillow-like body, you will be tormented by nightmares.

name: Ralts Goth
description: Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head, and feeds off of the fear of others... Unfortunately, its also a scaredy-cat itself. It will often jump out to scare people, only to get spooked when they scream.

name: Roselia Wither
description: This Pokemon's roses have withered and turned black. Its pollen is highly poisonous, causing severe pain and anguish for anyone who inhales it... Prolonged exposure to this pollen will lead to a slow and painful death.

name: Roserade Wither
description: Its petals emit a toxin so powerful it can stop a man's heart with a single touch. When it encounters another living being, it mindlessly attacks them with sharp thorns coated in these same toxins.

name: Sewaddle Clockwork
description: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokemon flutters around, using its little claws to scratch off dust and decay. It continues this task even centuries after it was created.

name: Shiinotic Crimson
description: This Shiinotic has evolved to match the Crimson Forest it lives in. The vines hanging from its mushroom cap are specialized to absorb heat from the Nether air, powering the Pokemon's inner light. It fires beams of light from its mushroom cap to burn its foes.

name: Shiinotic Warped
description: This Shiinotic has evolved to match the Warped Forest it lives in. It lures in prey with its hypnotic lights, before coating them in mind-controlling spores.

name: Starstellation Aspect=Mega
description: Mega Starstellar is seemingly designed for spcae travel, being able to withstand the cold darkness of the cosmos. Some theorize this is the form it had before it came to this planet.

name: Stonjourner Sandstone
description: This Pokemon forth a sandstorm.

name: Swadloon Clockwork
description: A robotic recreation that resembles the Pokemon Swadloon. It was built to withstand intense heat, carrying out its task in spite of harsh conditions. Over time, however, its heatproofing has become less reliable than it once was.

name: Tangela Lush
description: Thick moss and vines cover its whole body, preventing anyone from seeing its true appearance. It has an intense fear of the dark, but fears showing its face even more. Because of this, it will stubbornly hide in the shadows if anyone approaches, even despite its fear.

name: Tanglare Lush Aspect=Mega
description: Mega Evolution has caused its flowers to bloom much larger and brighter than before. Using the vine on its head its able to hang down from cave ceilings, letting its spores drift down below.

name: Tanglare Lush
description: Because its entire body is obscured by moss and vines, scientists are unsure how it propels itself through the air. When threatened, it will shake its body to create a cloud of spores before disappearing into the shadows.

name: Trevenant Pale
description: In the dark of the night, it lurks through the dead and decaying forest it used to live in when it was alive. It unleashes the forest's rage on those who tarnished its homeland, and brutally attacks any intruders who enter its domain. Its body is made of petrified wood.
